note: One plain sentence per reason code in contracts/reason_codes.json. Written by hand because Sarvam-30B access was not available; if regenerated with an LLM, change `source` and have a human review every line (never on the live path). Codes are never renamed (M2), so keys here only grow.

strings.F_UNK_CONTACT_RECENT: Someone who isn't in your contacts reached you in the last 2 hours.
strings.F_UNK_CALL_ACTIVE: You're on a call with someone who isn't in your contacts.
strings.F_UNK_VIDEO_ACTIVE: You're on a video call with someone who isn't in your contacts.
strings.F_MINS_SINCE_UNK_LOG: This started only a few minutes after an unknown person first contacted you.
strings.F_INSTALL_PLAY_DURING_UNK: An app was installed from Google Play while an unknown person was in touch with you.
strings.F_INSTALL_SIDELOAD_DURING_UNK: An app was installed from outside Google Play while an unknown person was in touch with you.
strings.F_WATCHLIST_APP: A remote-access or screen-sharing app was installed or opened. Scammers use these to watch or control a phone.
strings.F_NEW_PAYEE: You're paying someone you have never paid before.
strings.F_PAYEE_ADDED_AFTER_UNK: You added this payee after an unknown person contacted you.
strings.F_LOG_AMT_RATIO: This amount is much larger than your usual payments.
strings.F_ROBUST_Z_POS: This amount is far outside your normal range.
strings.F_REPEAT_TO_PAYEE: You have already paid this person several times in this session.
strings.F_IS_P2P: This is a payment to a person, not to a shop or business.
strings.F_OCSS_ORDERED: Things happened in the order scammers usually follow: contact, an app install, a new payee, then the payment.
strings.F_NEWPAYEE_X_AMT: This is a large amount to someone you have never paid before.
strings.F_UNK_X_NEWPAYEE: A new payee appeared shortly after an unknown person contacted you.
strings.RULE_SIDELOAD_DURING_CALL: An app was installed from outside Google Play while an unknown person was in touch with you.
strings.RULE_LONG_SESSION: You have been in a video call with an unknown person for 2 hours or more.
